title: ZGateway: Learnings from Putting a Proxy in Front of ZippyDB
summary: Replaces ZippyDB's connection mesh, where fan-in grew with clients and reconnect storms crashed hosts, with ZGateway.

title: GEM Training: How Meta Doubled the Efficiency of Its LLM-Scale Ads Foundation Model
summary: Cuts padding waste and exposed communication in GEM training with jagged attention and topology-aware parallelism.

title: Meta's AI Storage Blueprint at Scale
summary: Ends GPU stalls from stacked BLOB metadata lookups with one flat ZippyDB schema and direct reads from Tectonic.

title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
summary: Folds the retrieval service mesh, whose hops capped model complexity and candidate count, into one PyTorch model.

title: Indexing code at scale with Glean
summary: Avoids a lowest-common-denominator schema in Glean by storing per-language facts and deriving language-neutral views.

title: Sequence learning: A paradigm shift for personalized ads recommendations
summary: Replaces aggregated features, which lose event order and detail, with event embeddings pooled by attention per ad.

title: RoCE networks for distributed AI training at scale
summary: Fixes poor ECMP spread of training's low-entropy elephant flows by adding queue pairs and hashing on the QP field.

title: Taming the tail utilization of ads inference at Meta scale
summary: Cuts timeouts on overloaded ads inference hosts by trading stale, host-wide load data for polled, per-model counters.

title: Scaling the Instagram Explore recommendations system
summary: Avoids running heavy models on every Explore candidate by caching user and item tower embeddings for early stages.

title: Building and deploying MySQL Raft at Meta
summary: Replaces failover scripts, whose locking and fencing were hard to make atomic, with Raft over the MySQL binlog.

title: Asynchronous computing at Meta: Overview and learnings
summary: Stops copying stream and warehouse data into FOQS by having per-source tailers push to a source-agnostic scheduler.

title: How Precision Time Protocol is being deployed at Meta
summary: Replaces NTP, too imprecise to swap quorum reads for timestamp waits, with PTP and fbclock's window of uncertainty.

title: Scaling data ingestion for machine learning training at Meta
summary: Stops DPP readers decoding whole feature maps by giving each feature its own stream, leaving more power for GPUs.

title: Cache made consistent
summary: Catches stale TAO entries from fills racing invalidations with Polaris, tracing only the race window to debug them.

title: Delta: A highly available, strongly consistent storage service using chain replication
summary: Ends the tail read hotspot in Delta, a chain-replicated bootstrap store, by letting any node serve clean versions.

title: FOQS: Making a distributed priority queue disaster-ready
summary: Stops items getting stuck after MySQL failover by handing each shard to a queue node in its primary's new region.

title: How we built a general purpose key value store for Facebook with ZippyDB
summary: Replaces each team's own replication on raw RocksDB with ZippyDB, a Multi-Paxos store with per-request consistency.

title: Migrating Facebook to MySQL 8.0
summary: Jumps from 5.6 to 8.0, where skipping 5.7 rules out in-place upgrades, by promoting logically copied 8.0 secondaries.

title: Fully Sharded Data Parallel: faster AI training with fewer GPUs
summary: Drops DDP's full model copy per GPU by splitting all-reduce so GPUs keep shards and gather a layer only to run it.

title: How Facebook encodes your videos
summary: Swaps coarse hard-coded encoding priorities for compression gain times predicted watch time over remaining compute.

title: FOQS: Scaling a distributed priority queue
summary: Spares each dequeue a reduce across MySQL shards with a prefetch buffer that k-way merges per-shard ready indexes.

title: Scaling services with Shard Manager
summary: Moves teams off partial home-grown sharding onto Shard Manager, where apps implement add_shard and drop_shard.

title: Managing data store locality at scale with Akkio
summary: Trades full data copies in every region, which stopped scaling, for Akkio moving microshards to where they are used.

title: Migrating Messenger storage to optimize performance
summary: Avoids lost writes when copying live accounts from HBase to MyRocks by retrying any whose log position moved.

title: Migrating a database from InnoDB to MyRocks
summary: Migrates space-bound UDB from InnoDB to MyRocks via cross-engine replication, which keeps InnoDB as a fallback.

title: LogDevice: a distributed data store for logs
summary: Keeps appends flowing when nodes fail or logs spike by decoupling sequencing from storage so copies land on any node.

title: MyRocks: A space- and write-optimized MySQL database
summary: Replaces InnoDB, whose fixed-size compressed pages waste space and random writes wear flash, with RocksDB under MySQL.

title: Apache Spark @Scale: A 60 TB+ production use case
summary: Merges a slow, hard-to-monitor pipeline of sharded Hive jobs into one Spark job, fixing the Spark bugs it exposed.

title: Under the hood: Facebook's cold storage system
summary: Cuts power and space spent on old photos with cold storage that powers one drive per tray, enforced in firmware.

title: Scaling the Facebook data warehouse to 300 PB
summary: Fixes ORCFile bloating high-entropy columns by dictionary-encoding a stripe only when it has few distinct values.

title: Needle in a haystack: efficient storage of billions of photos
summary: Replaces per-photo NFS files, whose metadata cost several I/Os a read, with Haystack's large files indexed in memory.
